name: Question 1
problem:
$$
{x}^{′}(t)=[\begin{aligned}0 & 2 \\ 2 & 0\end{aligned}]x+[\begin{aligned}{e}^{2t} \\ 0\end{aligned}],\,x(1)=[\begin{aligned}3 \\ 1\end{aligned}]
$$

Write down the expression that gives the solution of the initial value problem above.

*Hint: ${e}^{At}=[\begin{aligned}\operatorname{cosh}⁡(2t) & \operatorname{sinh}⁡(2t) \\ \operatorname{sinh}⁡(2t) & \operatorname{cosh}⁡(2t)\end{aligned}],$ where $A=[\begin{aligned}0 & 2 \\ 2 & 0\end{aligned}].$*

| $x(t)=\,\,$ |  | $3\operatorname{cosh}⁡(2(t-1))+\operatorname{sinh}⁡(2(t-1))$ |  | $\,\,+{\int }_{1}^{t}\,\,$ |  | {{field-1}} |  | $\,\,\text{d}s$ |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
|  | {{field-2}} |  |  | ${e}^{2s}\operatorname{sinh}⁡(2(t-s))$ |  |  |  |  |
